features: 4-in-1 Keychain Cable for All Devices: This compact keychain cable supports 4 output modes — Type-C to Type-C (60W), Type-C to 8-Pin (20W), USB-A to Type-C (15W), and USB-A to 8-Pin (15W) — making it perfect for charging all your devices with a single cable.

description: The Portronics Keylink 4-in-1 Keychain Charging Cable is a compact, portable solution that combines four essential charging outputs in one sleek design—Type-C to Type-C (60W), Type-C to 8-Pin (20W), USB-A to Type-C (15W), and USB-A to 8-Pin (15W)—making it universally compatible with smartphones, tablets, and laptops. With both USB-A and Type-C input heads, it’s perfect for power banks, wall adapters, and laptops. This 25cm mini cable comes with a sturdy red keyring loop so you can easily attach it to your keys or bag, ensuring charging convenience on the go. Built with durable PVC material and metal + rubber connector heads, it’s designed to withstand everyday wear and tear. Despite its small size, it supports fast charging and data syncing, letting you power up or transfer files in a flash. Ideal for travel, work, or emergency use, the Keylink keychain cable eliminates cable clutter while keeping you prepared for every device—anytime, anywhere.
